examples.arabic: ماما اشترت تفاح أحمر ومانجا صفرا طازة.
examples.english: Mom bought fresh red apples and yellow mangoes.
examples.transliteration: Mama eshtaret toffah ahmar we manga safra taza.

examples.arabic: هناك، الراجل بيبيع خضار طازة وبيقول: 'كام كيلو عايزة يا ست الكل؟' وأنا بقول له: 'عايزة كيلو بطاطس و اتنين كيلو طماطم من عندك'.
examples.english: There, the man sells fresh vegetables and says: 'How many kilos do you want, madam?' And I tell him: 'I want one kilo of potatoes and two kilos of tomatoes from you.'
examples.transliteration: Honak, el ragel byebaaʾ khoḍar taza w byeqool: 'Kam kilo ʾayza ya sitt el kol?' W ana baqoolloh: 'ʾAyza kilo batates w etnein kilo tamatem men ʾandak'.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: بعدين، أحمد اشترى عيش طازة لأمه وإخواته.
examples.english: Then, Ahmed bought fresh bread for his mother and sisters.
examples.transliteration: Badeen, Ahmed eshtara eish taza le ommo w ekhwato.

examples.english: I buy fresh fruit for the house
examples.transliteration: ana bashteri faka taza lel beit

examples.english: The vegetables are fresh and cheap.

examples.arabic: ستي بتحب تشتري خضار طازة وحاجات قديمة
examples.english: My grandma likes to buy fresh vegetables and old things
examples.transliteration: Settī betehebb teshtary khodar tazza w hagāt adīma
